Complex care in Blacktown

Nurse-led complex care across Blacktown

Abundance Healthcare Group is a registered NDIS provider (Reg ID 4-JCLD6XE) delivering complex and clinical NDIS care in Blacktown. We take on the high-intensity and nurse-led cases that many providers cannot.

Whether a participant needs high-intensity daily personal activities, complex community nursing, hospital-to-home transition or 24/7 support, we coordinate it under registered-nurse governance across Blacktown and the surrounding area.

What we deliver in Blacktown

Complex supports available in Blacktown

Each support is delivered by a nurse-led team and backed by our NDIS registration. Pick the one that matches the participant's needs.

  • High-Intensity Daily Personal ActivitiesNurse-supervised high-intensity personal care, registration group 0104.
  • Complex Community NursingPEG feeding, complex bowel care, wounds and catheter care by registered nurses.
  • 24/7 & High-Intensity In-Home SupportActive overnight, sleepover and around-the-clock support at home.
  • Complex Hospital-to-Home SupportNurse-coordinated transitions home for medically complex participants.
  • Complex Mental Health & PsychosocialPsychosocial disability support, including co-occurring physical needs.
  • Culturally Responsive CareWorkers matched to language and culture, including African community support.
